headlines.text: Flash back to 2023, when there was a changing of the guard for the AEW TNT Title as Samoa Joe vs. Darby Allin battled it out in a No Holds Barred match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.84 ? an outstanding performance from both sides ? ending the champion's reign at 7 defenses. Joe avenged his earlier loss in a No Holds Barred rematch, taking the TNT Championship back from Allin just four days before facing him again in that same city.

On this day in 2025, FTR vs. Moxley & Yuta fought it out in a Mid-South Street Fight match, in the show-closing main event slot on Collision, rated 7.38 ? a strong outing in a hard-hitting tag team clash.

It was 2023 when Timothy Thatcher competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Bryan Danielson, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.41 ? a strong outing. Making his AEW debut at Bryan Danielson's personal request, the veteran grappler flew in from Tokyo for a single day just to test himself against the American Dragon.

secondaries.text: That Saturday in 2025, Daniel Garcia vs. Kyle O'Reilly vs. Lee Moriarty went to battle over the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Collision, rated 7.05 ? a match that delivered.
Rewind to 2023, when Dynamite stood out as one of AEW's best-received shows of the year, rated 8.92.
Looking back to 2023, when Konosuke Takeshita vs. Brian Cage met for the very first time on Dynamite, rated 7.27 ? a good, competitive contest.
